items.title: Chazz Frichtel interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, June 13, 2016
items.q: Oh and Dean Parks was playing guitar.

ctx.x: Do you ever hear things on television or on the radio that you played on?

Yeah. I hear maybe the most played thing that I hear is this theme from this TV show called “Saved by the Bell” which I ended up playing bass on and I also ended up singing the lead vocal and background vocals with a friend of mine, Sunny Wilkinson. So every now and then — it’s still being played on cable and it tickles me because we never expected, we didn’t know what this was going to be. I happened to know the guy that wrote the theme. He heard me sing at his company’s Christmas party. And that’s why I got the…
Oh like you’re going to get paid for the date.
